name: rag-ejemplo
description: Ejemplo didáctico de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) con React, TypeScript y Node

scripts.dev: npm run build -w core && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w core && npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w core && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.build:pages: npm run build -w core && npm run build:pages -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w core && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
